name: zclass_node_assign_int32_to_di_recursive
description: zClass_Node::AssignInt32ToDiRecursive toggles DI flag bit 0 for a node's display instance pointer and recursively applies the same value to listB children.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this recursive node helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass node/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4528e0 validates the fastcall node/value arguments, direct non-null display-instance pointer check from node offset 0x3c, conditional zDi::SetFlagBit0 call, and forward recursion over listB children.
The native zClass predicate helper smoke verifies both set and clear operations propagate through a parent/child/grandchild tree and skip nodes without display-instance user data.
